column1: # Differential shaping corpus: HarfBuzz, FreeType and Pango read this file.
# One case per line, tab-separated, no header: id, font, codepoints, dir, size.
# codepoints are space-separated hex, no U+ prefix — unambiguous in any editor,
# in either direction, with no escapes to misread. dir is auto, ltr or rtl and
# goes to both engines unchanged. size is pixels; 32 keeps one design unit near
# one pixel on a 2048-upm face without hiding subpixel decisions.
# The texts are the ones this engine was measured against while being built, not
# a random sample: every joining shape, every lam-alef context, marks above and
# below and stacked, Persian digits, a ZWNJ-separated pair, a Latin run inside
# Arabic, and a Latin line with a ligature and digits in it.
